title: Agụụ n'ime Ụlọ Nsọ
intro: Ị banyere n'ebe nsọ dị jụụ wee hụ otu ohu Allah raara onwe ya nye ka ọ na-ekpe ekpere. Aka ha na-ebuli elu, anya ha na-ebuli elu, obi ha na-ebukwa agụụ nke dịteworo aka. Ònye bụ mkpụrụ obi a nwere ndidi nke ntụkwasị obi ya na Allah na-adịghị ada ada?
clues: Ejiri m ọtụtụ afọ fee Chineke na ekpere, na-ahụ ọrụ ebube ndị mere ka okwukwe m sie ike.
E nyere m ọrụ ilekọta nwa ọhụrụ dị ngọzi n'ebe nsọ ahụ.
Ka m na-aka nká, ihe kacha ewute m bụ na enweghị m nwa, n'ihi na nwunye m bụ nwa aga, anyị abụọ emeela agadi.
Ekpere m ekpere nye Onyenwe m maka onye ga-anọchi m n'ezinụlọ m, onye ga-anọgide na-abụ onye amụma.
Mgbe m guzoro n'ebe a na-ekpe ekpere, ndị mmụọ ozi kpọrọ m, na-asị, 'Chineke na-enye gị ozi ọma', egwu na ụjọ jidere m.
A gwara m na m ga-amụ nwa nwoke aha ya bụ Yahya, aha a na-akpọtụbeghị onye ọ bụla mbụ, nakwa na agaghị m agwa ndị mmadụ okwu ruo ụbọchị atọ.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ọghọm na ịka nká ebe ị na-achọ onye ga-eketa ihe nketa ezi omume
Ịbụ onye azụ̀ dị egwu loro
Ịtụfu alaeze n'aka onye ọchịchị aka ike
Ịbụ onye a chụpụrụ n'obodo ya
trial.answer: Ọghọm na ịka nká ebe ị na-achọ onye ga-eketa ihe nketa ezi omume

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: E nyere ya nwa nwoke ezi omume ma kwuo okwu ọzọ mgbe ụbọchị atọ nke ịgbachi nkịtị gasịrị
Iju mmiri bibiri ya n'ihi ekweghị ekwe
E nyere ya alaeze ukwu na njikwa n'elu ifufe
outcome.answer: E nyere ya nwa nwoke ezi omume ma kwuo okwu ọzọ mgbe ụbọchị atọ nke ịgbachi nkịtị gasịrị

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
